changelog:
Initial release of manga-panel-generator.

- Generate professional black-and-white manga panels and comic pages with authentic Japanese manga art style.
- Supports dynamic poses, screentones, and classic shonen, shojo, or seinen aesthetics.
- Requires a Neta AI API token for image generation.
- Includes options for panel size and style inheritance via reference images.
- Offers quickstart command examples and installation instructions.
summary: Generate professional black-and-white manga panels and comic pages with dynamic poses, screentones, and authentic Japanese manga art style. Perfect for manga...
